basic_profile.bio: I'm a mechanical engineer from Seattle, WA with a newfound passion for 3D printing. I recently got into this hobby after a friend gifted me a 3D printer. I enjoy exploring different filaments and tinkering with firmware to optimize my prints. Besides 3D printing, I have a deep love for classic films and I often participate in discussions about them. I work full-time at an engineering firm, so my online hours are mostly in the evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time hiking and watching classic movies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in mechanical engineering, which gives me a good foundation for understanding the mechanics of 3D printing. Most of my knowledge about 3D printing is self-taught through online tutorials, forums, and trial and error with my own printer.
